elispBefore: (require 'color) (require 'cl-lib) (unless (fboundp 'color-blend) (defun color-blend (color1 color2 alpha) (let* ((rgb1 (if (stringp color1) (color-name-to-rgb color1) color1)) (rgb2 (if (stringp color2) (color-name-to-rgb color2) color2))) (unless (and (listp rgb1) (listp rgb2) (= (length rgb1) 3) (= (length rgb2) 3)) (error "Invalid color value(s): %s %s" color1 color2)) (cl-mapcar (lambda (c1 c2) (+ (* alpha c1) (* (- 1 alpha) c2))) rgb1 rgb2))))
